page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 504.0 GB of system memory. This memory configuration provides approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators.

A key characteristic of this server type is its integrated local storage capacity. It is equipped with 30065 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, distributed across 8 local SSD drives. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers a high ratio of local NVMe storage to compute resources, making it a specialized option for workloads requiring massive local scratch space or high-throughput local database operations. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities. This hardware profile is designed for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and intensive transactional workloads that depend on high-capacity, low-latency local storage.
